description.narrative: The Crisis Risk Network is designed to help countries and communities navigate an increasingly uncertain global environment marked by economic shocks, political instability, climate change, and rapid technological change. The initiative, led by UNDP in partnership with governments, UN agencies, and technical experts, aims to safeguard development gains and reduce reliance on humanitarian assistance by integrating risk awareness and resilience into all aspects of planning and programming. Central to its approach are data-driven analysis, early warning systems, and adaptive strategies that enable UNDP, UN and stakeholders to anticipate and mitigate crises. The Network provides services such as risk diagnostics, decision support, policy and institutional support, and innovative financing tools to governments and the wider UN system. It also fosters a global community of practice through collaborative partnerships and knowledge-sharing platforms like the Crisis Academy, positioning UNDP as a leader in advancing risk-informed development and supporting sustainable progress even in fragile contexts.
